name: mangowrite-extension
description: Browser extension that captures papers (CNKI, Wanfang, CQVIP, IEEE, arXiv, DSpace, Web of Science …) into your MangoWrite library. PDF first.
author: aidenchen

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-build-info.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/content.ts --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --target=chrome110 --outfile=dist/content.js && esbuild src/background.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=chrome110 --outfile=dist/background.js
